arguments.description: Returns voucher list totals (grand total and total due) for the current filters. Put type, date range, pagination, sort, search, branch, and voucherVersion on the query string. Send optional filter fields in the JSON body — never put type in the body (returns INVALID_PARAMETER). Part of the Get All Vouchers Balances APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

type.description: Voucher list type. Required on the query string for a valid response. Allowed values: sales, invoice, payment, receipt, credit note, debit note. Default: sales.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; required when the company uses branches.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Panel sends this on the query string. Default: 1.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: voucherDate, dueDate, voucherNumber.

q.description: Search on account name, uniqueName, or voucher number.

voucherVersion.description: Use 2 so the request is handled by the accounting microservice (same as the Giddh panel). Default: 2.

noteType.description: Optional credit/debit note subtype when type is a note list.

sortBy.description: Sort field (mirrors query; panel also sends in body).

selectAllFields.description: Column/export field selection for list views.
